verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page claims built-in AI agents that you task by describing a control, and they then collect, validate, and package evidence on a schedule. That is in-product delegation, but it is limited to evidence collection and backed only by marketing copy. The documented MCP/OAuth path lets an external assistant act as you, so it is not a built-in assistant. missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant, documentation of how tasks are delegated and reviewed, any coverage beyond evidence collection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
